instructions: Each entry is one page to draft and publish. Follow the design system in public/faq/courier-usa-ecuador.html and the recently built public/envios-nueva-york-ecuador.html (same <head> structure: gtag G-XJ453CZKE2, Meta Pixel 37920610070886037, JSON-LD Article + FAQPage, CSS variables --bg/--fg/--accent(#ff9500)/--border/--shadow, wa-float button, cur-year footer script). Lead with 'Estados Unidos' as primary keyword, use 'USA' naturally as secondary, mention 'Nueva York' as the trust/differentiation signal (YoTeTraigo operates its own warehouse there, not just an intermediary). Pricing facts: $30 per 4 lb, $50 per 8 lb, seguro incluido, 10-14 dias, vuelo directo a Quito 3x semana, retiro en Quito incluido or +$10 to other cities via ServiEntrega. Regimen 4x4: hasta 4kg y $400 FOB, arancel fijo $20 + FODINFA 0.5%, limite anual $1600 USD, celulares/laptops = Categoria C con IVA 15%. Never fabricate specific competitor pricing as fact -- use qualifiers ('referencial', 'consultar') like the existing blog/top-10-casilleros-virtuales-usa-ecuador.html does. Never fabricate customs/regulatory specifics not already established on this site -- flag uncertainty instead of guessing. Write genuinely differentiated content per page, not a template with names swapped. After writing: (1) save as public/<slug>.html, (2) add a <url> entry to public/sitemap.xml with today's date as lastmod, (3) link the new page from a sensible existing page's related-links or footer if natural, (4) run npm run deploy from the project root, (5) mark this entry's status as 'published' with today's date in this file.

pages.brief: Two audiences in one page: (1) Ecuador-based people/small businesses who already move packages informally for others and want to formalize it as a real business, (2) USA-based Ecuadorian community businesses (leans on the Nueva York angle) who want a logistics partner. Positioning per the approved homepage copy: 'Tienes clientes que compran en USA? Convierte esos clientes en un negocio de envios a Ecuador.' Cover: how the agent model works, preferential volume rates, EquaLatin backing, WhatsApp support. Link to homepage #agentes section.

pages.brief: Note: SHEIN already ships to Ecuador directly in many cases -- be factually careful here, do not claim it doesn't ship to Ecuador if that's not verified. Frame the page around the actual value prop: consolidating SHEIN orders with other US purchases into one flat-rate YoTeTraigo shipment instead of paying SHEIN's own international shipping per order, and using the US site's fuller catalog/sizing vs the Ecuador storefront if one exists. Flag uncertainty rather than asserting shipping behavior you can't confirm.

pages.title_direction: Casillero virtual vs envio internacional directo: cual conviene
also_target: conviene mas un casillero o envio directo
pages.brief: Comparison content, factual not promotional per the runbook's own editorial rule. Structure: cost per item when a store DOES ship directly to Ecuador (often high per-order international shipping) vs consolidating multiple purchases through a casillero's flat rate. Be honest about when direct international shipping actually wins (e.g. a single large/heavy item, or a store with genuinely cheap direct Ecuador shipping) -- don't oversell the casillero model where it doesn't fit.

pages.brief: Combined allowed/restricted-items guide (deliberately one page, not two, to avoid a thin 'what I can't ship' page). Reuse the restricted-items facts already stated on this site (medicamentos controlados, alimentos perecederos, baterias de litio sueltas -- from faq/courier-usa-ecuador.html and blog/top-10-casilleros-virtuales-usa-ecuador.html) rather than inventing a new list.
